paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (estimated from paper's statement of DFSZ-level sensitivity over the scanned mass range)
notes: CAPP-MAX (formerly CAPP-12TB) cavity haloscope search covering 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 ueV). Paper reports the most stringent exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling in this range at ~90% CL, assuming axions constitute 100% of local DM with rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3 (Fig. 22). No numerical table of limit values is provided in the text; data points here are approximate DFSZ-level values (g_DFSZ = alpha/(2*pi*f_a)*0.75) reconstructed from the paper's claim of reaching 'at or near DFSZ sensitivity' across the scanned range. Portions (1.0267-1.0443 GHz, 1.1220-1.1229 GHz) used HEMT first-stage amplification with somewhat weaker limits; several mode-crossing gaps exist (e.g. 1.0881, 1.0947, 1.129-1.135, 1.1705, 1.1762 GHz). Actual per-bin limits should be digitized from Fig. 22 for precision.
